viewing_check: Look for maker stamps on the toes/heels of both plough planes (Mathieson, Marples, Preston, Sorby, Greaves, any Australian maker), brass arm and fence condition, number of irons, whether any have boxwood/ivory tips; also the lever cap or logo on the No 4 (Stanley, Record, Bailey) and whether the No 4 is cracked.
